description: Spec v1.0 name for liquidity_map: each venue type with whether the evidence read shows depth at the size, slippage and landing cost with a Rate Receipt, or Being measured with the reason. Same arguments as liquidity_map.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

amount.description: Ticket size, in the from currency unless amount_currency says otherwise.

amount_currency.description: The from or the to currency. Default from.

from.description: ISO 4217 code of the source currency (what leaves), e.g. 'ZAR'.

pair.description: e.g. EUR-ZMW. Or from and to.

to.description: ISO 4217 code of the destination currency (what lands), e.g. 'USD'.

name: check_provider_liquidity
title: Liquidity at this payment's size
